summary.text: Michael Boutin is a Republican state representative from Vermont's Washington-3 District who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a school board member.

paragraphs.text: Michael Boutin was born in Connecticut, and his career experience includes working as a school board member.
Boutin assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
